description: Today's word puzzle, the same for everyone: a five letter word in 6 tries. The server picks the word and checks each guess, so you never see it until the round ends. Call with no guess to start, then pass the player's guess with the round_id. Free, with a day streak: pass streak_key (st_...) if the player has one. hard (six letters) and day (a past date) are for Playtable Club and need pro_code.

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a past day. Club only.

pro_code.description: A Playtable Club code, for hard mode and past days. It also keeps the streak.
